persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrī jayabhūpatīndramalladevasana śrī3kaumārīskelu polalayā gajuli cchāyatā dayakā juro

purpose: śrī3kaumārīskelu polalayā gajuli cchāyatā dayakā juro
notes: King Bhūpatīndramalla of Bhaktapur is mentioned in the Newari colophon note recording his donation/installation of the finial (gajuli) and ritual consecration for Kaumārī.
